column1: # Hotel RMS - Public Holidays & Special Events Calendar
# This is the ONLY calendar input used by "hotel rms.py". Staff can edit this
# file in Excel or Notepad; no code changes are needed. Save as UTF-8 CSV.
# Columns
#   Date          YYYY-MM-DD for a one-off date
#                 Recurring=Y for a date that repeats every year.
#   Event_Name    Free text shown in the reports. Leave it empty to use the
#                 generic "Public Holiday Demand Window Triggered" reason.
#   Event_Factor  Demand multiplier applied to the recommended rate.
#                 1.00 = neutral
#                 Practical range 0.50 - 3.00; values outside it still work.
#   Category      Public Holiday | Special Event | School Holiday | Custom
#   Recurring     Y = repeat on the same MM-DD every year; N/blank = one-off.
# Rules
#   - A YYYY-MM-DD one-off row overrides a recurring MM-DD row on that date.
#   - If two rows of the same kind share a date
#   - Lines starting with # and blank lines are ignored.
#   - Only dates inside the 90-day pricing window are priced.
#   - A missing or invalid file stops the run with a clear error message.
# Annual maintenance
#   The Recurring=Y rows below are fixed-date entries and carry over
#   automatically to every future year. Movable dates change every year and
#   MUST be added as new YYYY-MM-DD rows before each new year:
#     Chinese New Year
#     Deepavali
#     and observed-in-lieu holidays.
#   Use the official Singapore public holiday calendar and the F1 race calendar.
Date
